title: Akoi Meexx: Re: Vault
description: An in-world block manipulation datapack designed to modify vault gameplay mechanics to allow for re-use.
body:
## Re: Vault

Re: Vault is a datapack that allows vault re-use after a trial key has been used on a vault.

**Features**
- Vault resets all rewarded players on key use

**Future Planned Features**
- Remove key use restriction (custom map/vault key support)
- Removal of only the activating player instead of all from rewarded players
- In-game advancements


## Technical Info
This pack functionally resets a vault's `server_data.rewarded_players` array to empty via raycasting in order to facilitate allowing vault re-use.
